title: Human review overrides
description: Reviewer decisions that amend or replace a derived endpoint specification. Keyed by outcome so a decision survives re-derivation.

outcome_uid.description: The outcome this decision is about. Not a spec_id: spec ids change with the derivation version, and a human decision must outlive that.

concept_id.description: The concept the reviewer says this outcome is. Explicit null means no concept in the vocabulary fits, which suppresses a wrong match rather than leaving it in place.

axes.description: Axis-level corrections applied over the derived values.

reason.description: Why. Required, because an override without a rationale is not reviewable by the next person.

source_hash.description: The outcome record_hash the decision was made against. When the registry text changes this no longer matches and the override goes stale instead of being applied to text nobody reviewed.

supersedes_concept_id.description: What the classifier had concluded, retained for audit.

status.description: Retired keeps the audit trail while stopping the decision being applied. Staleness is computed, not declared here.
